name: Drochtersen (Germany)
description: White field with narrow red stripes along the top and bottom edges, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Drochtersen (three red embattled chevrons on white).
history: Municipal flag of Drochtersen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Drochtersen arms — three embattled chevrons on white
